old_evidence: O9 native dual-OS and full FORGE regression success, scientific no-go, same frozen architecture and losses preserved; O2-O8 original positive/negative evidence retained; Q20, Q21/Q21N01 protected source roles untouched
scientific_question: When trained recurrent networks fail delayed-memory composition, is public cue/action-parity information absent from the learned state, or present but inaccessible to the network's trained query decoder? Test frozen-state, TRAIN-fitted readout probes against random initialization, state erasure, and explicit public-history information witness.

pre_registered_hypotheses.H_ENCODING: A probe trained on *frozen recurrent state* has poor O10_PUBLIC_DEV cue and resettable-parity decoding despite sufficient public information in explicit history; failure is state formation/credit assignment, not solely final readout.
pre_registered_hypotheses.H_READOUT: Frozen trained state probes predict query target materially better than original output head; failure primarily readout optimization, not representational capacity.
pre_registered_hypotheses.H_BASELINE: A probe on UNTRAINED same-size recurrent state is a confound control for random reservoir encodings; report any success there, never attribute to learned memory.
pre_registered_hypotheses.H_NULL: Do not count gains on independent iid query bits as memory progress.

seed_derivation: SHA256 UTF8 namespace:role:family:index first 8 bytes big-endian -> random.Random

families.ECHO_WITH_RESETS: Public initial observation cue bit at t=0; at nonquery steps iid public actions in {0,1,3} and iid fair next-bit distractions; only query action 2 yields initial cue XOR independent noise bit probability .05
families.RESETTABLE_PARITY: Identical public cue, query time, action and distractor laws; query target = initial cue XOR parity of public action=1 events SINCE latest public reset action=3 before the query, XOR Bernoulli(.05)
families.NULL_IID: Identical public nonquery histories and query timing/action law, query target iid fair Bernoulli .5

learner_input: Only current public observation (0/1), action (0,1,2,3), and t==0; recurrent previous state. Note action 3 is distinguishable as all three action-one-hot bits zero; original O9 model otherwise byte-identical. Target next query bit revealed only after prediction for TRAIN fitting; public history labels cue/parity are allowed ONLY in separately marked diagnostic TRAIN probe supervision, never added to original neural networks.

main_comparisons.TRAINED_EXTERNAL_2_NATIVE_HEAD: Original immutable O9 2-slot learned external write/read code Git blob to be exact-pinned, two seeds 17/31, 12 epochs Adam query-only BPTT, choose by SELECT native query-NLL
main_comparisons.TRAINED_GRU_2_NATIVE_HEAD: Original immutable O9 two-cell GRU with same 12 epochs/two starts/SELECT, train on same public episodes
main_comparisons.FROZEN_STATE_TARGET_PROBE: For each SELECT-chosen trained model freeze ALL recurrent weights; fit logistic readout using frozen query-time 2-cell hidden state + current query public observation/action (which are the only native query direct features). TRAIN labels = actual query next bit. Choose no hyperparameters on DEV.
main_comparisons.FROZEN_STATE_CUE_PROBE: Same frozen state; TRAIN target initial PUBLIC cue (public observable), sigmoid logistic probe, score cue NLL on DEV. Diagnostic supervision only; no native model update.
main_comparisons.FROZEN_STATE_PARITY_PROBE: Same frozen state; TRAIN target PUBLIC parity since last action=3; score parity NLL on DEV. Diagnostic supervision only.
main_comparisons.RANDOM_UNTRAINED_STATE_TARGET_PROBE: Original same-architecture model with chosen initialization but *untrained* recurrent weights; fit identical target logistic probe on TRAIN to detect reservoir encoding.
main_comparisons.ERASED_NATIVE_HEAD: Same trained model, clear history state immediately before query without retraining; NLL on DEV.
main_comparisons.CURRENT_QUERY_COUNTS: Train Laplace+1 Bernoulli counts on current public query observation and query delay only.
main_comparisons.EXPLICIT_PUBLIC_MEMORY_COUNTS: Train Laplace+1 Bernoulli counts with public initial cue and action parity since last reset; deliberately engineered full-history control, source information sufficiency witness, NOT capacity matched.

frozen_fit.linear_probe_input: bias, current query observation, hidden state components (2), identical for frozen learned and random state probes
frozen_fit.model_choice: minimum O10_PUBLIC_SELECT original native-head NLL for each recurrent architecture. After selection, freeze model before fitting any TRAIN-only probes. No model selection, tuning or fit on O10_PUBLIC_DEV.
frozen_fit.probe_model: One trained logistic regressor with full-batch gradient, deterministic initialization zero. Do not allow cue/parity labels as input; they are TRAIN-only diagnostic target.
frozen_fit.null: Retain all null-family apparent signal, never claim positive because of noisy 24-query DEV.

decision_and_cost.primary: For each family and architecture report signed original native-head query NLL, frozen-state trained query-head NLL and random-untrained state query probe NLL, cue NLL, parity NLL, erased-state NLL and explicit conventional fitted controls.
decision_and_cost.encoding: Learned-vs-random cue and parity probe differences; randomized baseline prevents attributing public-history encoding to learned state merely because untrained reservoir retains weak signal.
decision_and_cost.readout: Native-head minus trained frozen-state target-probe NLL; extra supervised readout has higher training budget; it is a diagnosis, never native improvement.
decision_and_cost.full_information: Compare against trained explicit public cue+reset-parity counts (hand-engineered, not equal learned features) and current-only counts.
decision_and_cost.costs: Model fitting/select CPU, probe fitting CPU, query inference CPU, checkpoint serialized bytes, trainable parameter count, peak traced allocations/RSS, whole-process CPU. Disclose extra supervision and no equal compute for probes.
decision_and_cost.cross_os: All 9 role × family SHA256 digests byte exact Windows/Linux; all 3 families × all model/probe outputs within 1e-6. Freeze trained checkpoint after train/SELECT and prove DEV read-only.
decision_and_cost.status: public-only mechanistic diagnostics; no independent science first-use, no native integration, no source custody advancement and no scientific GO.

next_boundary: If trained-state cue/parity decoding fails even as explicit history succeeds, a subsequent prospectively frozen investigation may compare event-specific auxiliary public learning signals against equally trained controls. Never retrofit an O10 negative after DEV.
